faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: A 20-part documentary podcast series on World War II narrated by Tom Hanks.
kurzfassung: Tom Hanks narrates a comprehensive 20-part documentary series exploring the history and human impact of World War II. The series covers the global scale of the conflict, highlighting both the worst and best of humanity. Listeners can experience these personal and historical stories across major podcast platforms.
stichpunkte: World War II lasted for six dark years and involved the entire globe
It is the largest event in human history with every life touched
The 20-part series is presented by Tom Hanks
The narrative focuses heavily on the true human cost of the war
Accounts show humanity at both its absolute worst and best
Many individuals were willing to sacrifice their lives for others
Every single person during the conflict had a unique story
Episodes are available on Apple, Spotify, and other podcast platforms

kapitel.titel: The Human Cost and Series Availability

beschreibung: Coming May 26th: World War II with Tom Hanks reexamines history’s most devastating conflict for a new century. Across twenty hours, the series traces the war’s full arc–from the rise of fascism to Hiroshima–uncovering the decisions, hidden networks, and lasting consequences that continue to shape our world.
